channel.description: Latest articles from The Golf Channel (golfchannel.com)

item.title: Sustainability, community ... and a little fun at the WM Phoenix Open
item.description: The WM Phoenix Open is known as the biggest party event on the PGA Tour. But there is more to it. WM highlights sustainability and community -- to go along with the fun -- at TPC Scottsdale.

item.title: Mr. Par-4 Hole-in-One discusses iconic moment 25 years ago
item.description: Andrew Magee joins "Golf Central" to discuss his iconic hole-in-one at the par-4 17th 25 years ago at TPC Scottsdale. The four-time PGA Tour winner also talks about his career and what he's up to nowadays.

item.title: Scottie Scheffler comes up short at WM Phoenix Open despite seven-birdie Sunday
item.description: The top-ranked player in the world made a charge up the leaderboard thanks to a bogey-free 64 on Sunday at TPC Scottsdale but fell short of his third win at WM Phoenix Open.

item.title: WM Phoenix Open 2026 prize money: How much does Gotterup win from $9.6 million purse?
item.description: Here's how much Chris Gotterup will earn from this year's WM Phoenix Open purse after rallying to win in a playoff over Hideki Matsuyama at TPC Scottsdale.

item.title: Gotterup wins WM Phoenix Open on first playoff hole as Matsuyama limps to the finish
item.description: Hideki Matsuyama's third WM Phoenix Open title was denied in a drama-filled playoff on Sunday at TPC Scottsdale. Chris Gotterup bested the Masters champion for his second win on Tour this year.

item.title: Hideki Matsuyama loses WM Phoenix Open after battling driver, late crowd distractions
item.description: Matsuyama had to back off two shots on the 18th hole because of audible noises from the crowd before ultimately losing his bid for a third WM Phoenix Open title to a walk-off birdie by Chris Gotterup.

item.title: Gotterup wins WM Phoenix Open in playoff over Matsuyama
item.description: Chris Gotterup spoke to Golf Channel's Ryan Lavner after his thrilling playoff win over Hideki Matsuyama at the 2026 WM Phoenix Open.

item.title: Matsuyama driver woes sink hopes for third WM Phoenix Open title
item.description: Hideki Matsuyama lost for the first time in his PGA Tour career carrying a lead into Sunday. His driver betrayed him throughout the final round, failing to hit a single fairway on the front nine. Matsuyama eventually lost a playoff to Chris Gotterup.

item.title: Pierceson Coody keeps top-25 streak going, tops Aon Swing 5 for Pebble, Genesis
item.description: Coody’s strong start to the season continued at the WM Phoenix Open, where the 26-year-old Coody tied for 10th. He will keep playing, too, as he qualified for his first two signature events via the Aon Swing 5.

item.title: PGA Tour Highlights 2026: WM Phoenix Open, final round
item.description: Highlights from the final round of the 2026 WM Phoenix Open, where it took a sudden-death playoff to determine the winner at TPC Scottsdale.
